template.description: Interpolated text inside the chrome. Same rules as templateEntry.

addLabel.description: Label on the add button. Omit for icon-only. {{path}} interpolates over this node's data.

fields.description: Nested object layout. Ignored when the entry is a $ref.

hidden.description: Not shown but still submits with the form.

itemLabel.description: Singular noun for array item controls (add, remove, empty state).

items.description: Describes inline array items. For $ref items, annotate the target schema instead; fields is ignored here.

label.description: null clears a key inherited from the default view or a ref target.

name.description: A single property name on the containing object. Never dotted. Nest with fields.

omit.description: Not part of the presentation at all.

view.description: View for the child Surface. Flows to descendants.

fieldDirection.description: Body flow. vertical: column (default). horizontal: wrapping row.

fieldLayout.description: Field chrome style. props: label next to value (default). stack: full-width blocks.

modeOverride.description: Per-mode overrides for decoration keys. Layout (fields, rest, items) stays per-view. null clears an inherited value.

rest.description: append: unlisted properties shown in schema order (default). omit: hidden.
Where unlisted properties appear. Absent: after listed fields. At most one per field list.

fields.description: Omit for a heading-only section. A section with no visible children is hidden.

label.description: Section heading. Empty string for an anonymous group with no heading.

widget.description: Kit treatment for the group. Unknown treatments degrade to a plain section.

spanEntry.description: Inline chrome for short prose or nested fields.

template.description: Interpolated text. Dotted keys allowed ({{actor.name}}). Always HTML-escaped. Missing keys render empty.

widget.description: Widget selection. When $kind is set, the entire widget value must conform to that kit schema's def. Without $kind, the renderer owned by name interprets the properties. Core does not validate $kind.

$kind.description: Absolute URI of the kit def this widget conforms to. Takes precedence over name in renderer resolution.

name.description: Short widget name; candidate key `widget:<name>` (fallback after `$kind`).

options.description: Nested renderer params. Top-level properties on widget are also allowed; both are open.

description: Presentation for one subject schema. No components, no code, no constraints.

defs.description: Per-def view blocks. defs.<name> targets #/$defs/<name> at every use site.

targetLibraries.description: Kit identifiers this annotation targets. Metadata for tooling only; core ignores this field.

views.description: Named views. default is the fallback.

title: Surface annotation document
